component.name: UFI Phone
component.summary: Call and text through a compatible UFI modem

description.p: UFI Phone is a desktop client for cellular calls and SMS through a compatible Qualcomm-based UFI003 LTE USB modem. It connects to the authenticated modem gateway over the modem's private local network.

ul.li: Place and answer ordinary cellular calls
Bridge call audio through PulseAudio or PipeWire
